# Sanitized archived transcript replay corpus

Each fixture is a concise deterministic sanitized archived-transcript-derived category. No fixture carries source session identifiers, timestamps, credentials, personal data, database identifiers, or network endpoints. The runner assigns local session-message IDs and timestamps while seeding. Categories cover completed durable cases and patterns, failed-approach pitfalls, intentionally underspecified candidates, true duplicates, and non-duplicate near neighbors.
